calls.reason: The packet contains no independent sample establishing how often DALL-E Mini omitted tomatoes. Marcus's report and adjacent compositionality studies cannot establish the claimed frequency.

Li et al. report dynamic entity representations in BART and T5, but Kim and Schuster identify substantial evaluation shortcuts. These studies leave both state tracking and the stronger claim about reference unsettled.

LongBench v2 shows substantial capability, while the hallucination studies show continuing failures. Neither establishes an eventual dead end, and the forecast has no deadline or clear architectural condition.

The InstructGPT study reports reduced toxicity but unchanged bias after human-feedback training. It does not test whether deficient reference, cognitive models or compositionality caused those problems.
